title: Integrated lower left density of a measure on ℝ (abstract Simon 4.10)
statement: Let ν be a measure on ℝ (Borel σ-algebra) and a, b ∈ ℝ. For t ∈ ℝ let g(t) := liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·ν((t − h, t)) ∈ [0, ∞], the liminf along the filter 𝓝[>] 0. Then the lower Lebesgue integral over (a, b) with respect to Lebesgue measure satisfies ∫⁻_{(a,b)} g(t) dt ≤ ν((a, b)), where ofReal : ℝ → [0, ∞] is ENNReal.ofReal. No finiteness of ν and no measurability of g is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ν (Ioo (t - h) t)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ν (Ioo a b)
